# `add_months`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the date that is `num_months` after `start_date`.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
add_months(start_date, num_months)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- add_months, example 1
> SELECT add_months('2016-08-31', 1);
2016-09-30
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.5.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
